verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is a scraping SaaS, so offering an official MCP server is a fair axis, and a probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at mcp.scrapingbee.com. The only evidence is that single probe line, so the depth of the integration is unverified. missing for 10: details of exposed MCP tools, auth/connection setup instructions, transport details, independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent
